audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Darius/Darius/Skill/Darius/Skill/Darius/Darius. The content whys under them read Darius x5 then Malphite twice, and the packet levelChart says the same. The chart currently hands Darius the two stages he actually loses and calls two stages he wins 'Skill'.
audit.why: Malphite's flip is an item timing, not a level: Ground Slam deals damage 'based on his Armor', so his first armour component makes it hit harder AND makes his own resists blunt a pure-AD Darius. Before that he owns nothing that beats a walk-up — Seismic Shard is 8s at 625 range and Granite Shield only holds 10% of his max health.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Darius through Level 6, Malphite at First item and Two+ items — proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Level 3 and Level 6 whys rewritten so the text stops calling them coin-flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why (First item) was generic Stridebreaker boilerplate — 'Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness' — attached to the one stage where the lane turns against you. spikes[2] also credits Malphite's tankiness to 'his passive shield plus W armor'; Thunderclap grants no armour anywhere in Riot's text.
audit.why: Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor', so every armour item he buys is an offensive purchase as well as a defensive one. That is the real first-item spike and it belongs to him, not to your Stridebreaker.
audit.corrected: First-item phase now names Ground Slam's Armor scaling as the reason the lane flips; spikes[2] swaps the invented 'W armor' for the actual Ground Slam interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this lane appears nowhere on the Darius side: Ground Slam reduces attack speed, and Darius' whole damage curve runs through attacks.
audit.why: Hemorrhage stacks off 'attacks and damaging abilities' and Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset, so cutting attack speed starves the bleed AND softens your reset in one 7s button. It is a flat 7s at every rank, which makes it the most punishable and most repeatable cooldown in the matchup. The mirror page (audits/top/malphite__darius.json) already states this from Malphite's side; this page did not state it from yours.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam's 7s attack-speed cut now appears in winCon, breakdown.early, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and the Lvl 3-5 spike, with the instruction to step in on the gap after he spends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thunderclap is referred to only as 'his W-empowered autos' and 'his W'. Neither the auto-attack reset nor the aftershock duration is stated.
audit.why: Thunderclap is 10s at rank 1 and carries the autoReset flag — his damage opens on an attack wind-up, not on a visible cast, so the tell you react to is the swing. 'For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him', which is why standing in front of him after the first hit is the mistake.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0] now names Thunderclap, its auto reset and the aftershock window.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why contains raw LaTeX leaking onto the page: 'Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely.'
audit.why: A formula fragment with a stray backslash renders as literal '\times' in the level chart. It also buries the only thing the reader needs at 6 against a stacking-armour target.
audit.corrected: Replaced with plain prose stating that the armour he is about to buy does nothing to Guillotine's true damage.
